title: Sensei Provider Port Observation Batch V1
description: The O2 observations-aggregate document: the ordered set of bounded streaming observations gathered for one request, with its own declared/computed digest. Observations are evidence attached to a Result/Receipt; they never drive an O1 transition directly.
$comment: Canonical producer/owner: globulario/sensei, golang/architecture/providerport. sequence_number is monotonically increasing starting at 1 within one batch -- monotonicity itself is a Go-level (not JSON-Schema-level) invariant, proved by this package's tests.

observation_batch_digest_sha256.$comment: Self-referential semantic digest of this document with this field zeroed before hashing.
